svg.title: Seedmap — offline Minecraft seed atlas
svg.desc: Enter a Minecraft Java 1.21.4 (Winter Drop) seed to explore its biomes and structures, tilt the map into a diorama, and measure a route. Runs entirely offline in this single SVG file.

canvas.aria-label: Generated seed map. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, and press M to measure.

div.span: Surface generation · every seed is its own world

aside.div: Click the map to place a point

Underground markers are placements, not entrances.
Diorama elevation is illustrative, not block-exact terrain.

section.div: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · M to measure · D for diorama · esc for a new seed
